# OpenStrata

Sovereign strata corporation operations — strata governance, treasury, and property-management tools on Bitcoin rails. BCFSA-aware software built for British Columbia first, config-driven everywhere.

## Core pages

- [Home / Dashboard](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/) — community operations dashboard
- [About](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/about) — trusted money, proven operations
- [Pitch](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/pitch) — investor deck with live data
- [Strata Tool](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/tools) — 30+ management modules
- [Building Template Wizard](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/tools/wizard) — generate a portable building config JSON
- [Compliance Knowledge Base](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/compliance) — SPA + BCFSA compliance reference
- [Legal Library](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/legal) — primary BC legal sources
- [Templates](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/templates) — governance, finance, and conveyancing workflows
- [FAQ](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/faq) — plain-language BC strata answers
- [Roadmap](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/roadmap) — go-to-market paths and phases
- [Docs](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/docs) — architecture and documentation hub
- [Blog](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/blog) — announcements and deep dives
- [RSS & API](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/rss) — feeds and REST endpoints
- [OpenStrata Spec](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/spec) — sovereign data portability standard
